name: Hair Nest
description: A landscape of glossy chestnut waves with a hollow at its heart.
lighting: Large soft top light, one shine band along every wave
subject: either
prompt: A styled hairpiece of real glossy chestnut hair, a long heavy length laid across a set in loose S-waves that fill the view, every strand real and continuous, with fine flyaways, natural tonal variation from copper to deep umber and the soft weight real hair has. One large soft light from above draws a bright ribbon of shine along the crest of each wave while the troughs fall into warm brown shadow. The waves part into a soft hollow, as if something could rest there with strands passing over and under it. No face, no scalp and no parting: only hair, photographed on set as a landscape with true photographic detail. Chestnut, copper and warm umber, glossy and sensual.
